description: A Flutter provider class 'CodegenProvider' managing form state and code generation logic for a code generator screen. It handles input fields for language, description, and document reference, and produces stub code snippets in various programming languages based on user input. Implements change notification to update UI accordingly.

classes.name: CodegenProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier subclass managing code generation state, including input fields, output, and the generation process.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the target programming language and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description prompt for code generation and notifies listeners.

methods.name: setDocRef
methods.description: Sets the optional document reference and notifies listeners.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the current description input is non-empty, indicating whether generation can proceed.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Asynchronously generates stub code based on current inputs, updating output fields and notifying listeners.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all input fields and output to default values, notifying listeners.
